downloadSub: Use only the official stores or website. After you install, come back here and apply to Roxy so you land in our agency — not a random one.
title: How to join Roxy
sub: Two easy ways. Pick one, then message us so we can add you to the agency WhatsApp group.

steps.title: Install BIGO Live
steps.text: Download the official app from Google Play, the App Store, or bigo.tv.

steps.title: Open the app and search **presido**
steps.text: In the search bar, type **presido**. Apply to be an official signed streamer with our agency.

steps.title: Tap our invitation and Accept
steps.text: Open [our official invite link]({invite}) and tap **Accept**. The agency is independent from BIGO LIVE itself, and minors cannot be contracted.

steps.title: Ask to join our WhatsApp group
steps.text: Chat us on WhatsApp and request the Roxy BC hosts group. That is where you drop questions and difficulties. We go guide you.

warning: **Important:** There are other agencies on the app. Always come back to us and register *only* through the link we send you, or by searching **presido**, so you land in Roxy — not somewhere else.
